text:
Priya (AE): Heads up — HalcyonHealth procurement pinged me this morning. They called a 68% WoW drop in API token spend and are asking if their invoices are ballooning because of model changes. They mentioned evaluating alternatives (price-focused) and want a cost/latency comparison.
Asha (CSM): I saw the same. Daily active callers down ~40% last week. Onboarding team reported a bunch of `502` retries hitting our proxy around Tue 09:00 UTC — might have spiked client-side fallback to smaller calls. Logs: `curl https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -> 502 x 46`
Miguel (Solutions Eng): Could be a routing/variant mismatch + caching not kicking in. Halcyon was on gptx-2 in Jan then moved to gptx-2-rc with higher per-token cost. Quick check: can you share the last 7 days of model variants? I can run a replay.
Ben (Customer Ops): Do we have seat churn or admin changes? Their account admin list changed on 2026-01-22 per our audit logs. Also payment method updated 3/4.
Priya (AE): Summary metrics pasted below (7d vs 14d):
- total_tokens: 162k -> 510k (down 68%)
- active_caller_count: 24 -> 40 (down 40%)
- avg_latency_p95: 320ms -> 290ms
They flagged cost per 1k tokens up by ~22% on invoice. They say "we didn't change usage patterns".
Asha (CSM): Also flagged: new ML lead (Samir) joined last week and is running vendor cost benchmarking. He asked for raw token-level billing to validate. They might prefer a vendor that shows deterministic pricing for embeddings-heavy features.
Miguel (Solutions Eng): Actionable triage steps I propose: 1) Verify model variant timeline + kernel toggles 2) Re-run a traffic replay with original request mix to reproduce cost delta 3) Turn on prefix caching + quantized variant for one route to show cost delta. Example quick command for a replay run:
```
redwood replay --account halcyon --days 7 --variant gptx-2 --out /tmp/halcyon-replay.json
redwood compare-cost --replay /tmp/halcyon-replay.json --variants gptx-2,gptx-2-quant
```
Asha (CSM): Good. Also need a short customer-facing deck for Samir comparing: per-token unit price, expected P95 latency, and a sample cost projection for their monthly 1.2M token baseline. Can someone draft a 2-slide summary?
Priya (AE): I'll draft the pricing slide + a 2-week Dedicated trial offer: reduced committed unit price and a simulated cost report from Redwood Optimize. Can we offer trial credits to mirror their current 1.2M tokens?
Miguel (Solutions Eng): I can generate the Optimize report and run the replay today. I'll produce a small config snippet to enable prefix caching for the targeted route:
```
{
  "route": "halcyon/infer",
  "model": "gptx-2-quant",
  "cache": {"prefix_cache": true, "ttl": 3600},
  "batching": {"max_tokens": 1024, "timeout_ms": 12}
}
```
Asha (CSM): I'll set the enablement call with Samir for Thursday 11am PT. @Priya please include procurement and their finance lead. Ben — can you pull the last 3 invoices and the token-level billing CSV and attach to the thread?
Ben (Customer Ops): On it. I created a ticket and uploaded invoices -> INC-9876 (https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INC-9876). CSV will be in the ticket by EOD.
triage-bot: Ticket INC-9876 created and assigned to customer-success. SLA: 72h follow-up.
Priya (AE): Proposed next steps: 1) Miguel runs replay + Optimize report (ETA: today EOW) 2) Ben attaches invoices & token CSV (ETA: EOD) 3) Asha schedules customer enablement (Thu 11am PT) 4) Priya to share 2-week Dedicated trial offer and draft slide (ETA: tomorrow noon) — target: get Samir a cost demo showing 15-30% savings via quantized variant or Dedicated pricing.
Asha (CSM): I'll prep a one-page playbook for the call: objectives, key metrics, success criteria (e.g., projected monthly savings >=15%, no regressions in P95).
Miguel (Solutions Eng): I'll paste replay artifacts and cost comparison into the ticket when done.
Priya (AE): Thanks everyone. @Asha please cc me in the calendar invite so I can own the commercial ask.
Asha (CSM): Will do. :thumbsup:
Ben (Customer Ops): CSV uploaded to INC-9876. :white_check_mark:
Priya (AE): Great. Let's aim to have the demo + offer in hand before the procurement check-in next week.
Asha (CSM): Agreed.
(emoji thread: :eyes: from Priya, :rocket: from Miguel)
